QuestInfo.name: Judging the Axe
QuestInfo.0: As the Mountain God said, if I got an axe from Dark Axestump, let's go to the Mountain God and ask him to see if it's indeed the steel axe.
QuestInfo.1: The Mountain God told me if I bring the #baxe#k that #r#o2130100##k had, then he'll look into it and see if it's indeed the steel axe of the tree cutter or not. I need to pick up an axe from Dark Stump and bring it back to the Mountain God.
QuestInfo.2: The Mountain God carefully looked through the axe that I picked up, and told me what kind of axe that was. If I ever find the tree cutter's steel axe, then I'll have to return it to the tree cutter who lives somewhere around the Black Mountain.

0.0: You brought the axe. Let me see it. I'll have to look at it from up close to see if it's the tree cutter's steel axe or not.

no.0: You'll need to show me the axe in order for me to judge the axe.

1.0: It looks like a name is engraved on it, but my eyes have failed me a long time ago, and I can't clearly see what's on it. Why don't you take a look at it?

yes.0: Look at it closely. If it is indeed the steel axe of the tree cutter, then bring it to #b#p2071011##k, who lives somewhere around the Black Mountain. If it isn't the tree cutter's axe, then bring the one that is.

item.0: If you bring the axe that #r#o2130100##k gave you, then I'll check and see if it is #b#t4031315##k or not.
